messages:
kai: Hey team — HelixHealth asked us to validate SparrowHawk-14B for their private deployment. Quick triage: feasible for a Q4 POC? Need perf, quant, and safety checks. customer=HelixHealth; target latency <120ms @8 req/s; seq=2048.

maria: Quick Q — do they want FP16 or int8 quant? They said "cost reduction" so probably int8, but confirm tokenizer compatibility.

oliver: I'll own quant experiments. Plan: smoke with batch=1 seq=512 (FP16) then try int8 variants (q4_i8, awq).

sophia: I'll own evals / quality regression. Need a reference prompt set + acceptance thresholds. @kai can you get top 200 production prompts from the product ticket?

kai: Yep, collecting now. Uploading to the request page: https://redwood.internal/requests/HLX-2345 — will have prompts by EOD.

quant-bot: Scheduled job created: job_id=qb-9021, runner=quant-node-12. Command:
```
/opt/redwood/bin/quantize --model /mnt/models/sparrowhawk-14b --mode int8 --out /tmp/sparrowhawk-14b-int8
```

maria: Perf checklist: peak GPU mem, tokens/sec, p95 single-token latency, throughput at 8 req/s, KV-cache growth over long sessions. Also check OOM risk with seq=2048.

oliver: Smoke results (FP16): peak GPU mem=41.2GB, p95 single-token=42ms, batch=1 seq=512. Tried int8 -> failed, attention kernel mismatch. Opening an issue.

oliver: (follow-up) Created issue #ML-7827 "sphawk int8 attention kernel mismatch" and pinged eng-runtime.

alex (eng-runtime): Can you paste kernel error log here?

oliver: Error snippet:
```
E tensorflow: kernel mismatch: aten_attn_optim_v2 not found for model config head_dim=64
stack: at compile/attn_fused.cpp:line 312
...
```

alex (eng-runtime): Yep, that's the fused-attn mapping problem. Will add a fallback kernel and re-run the int8 path. ETA: tomorrow morning.

kai: Prioritization: mark this P1 customer request. If kernel fix lands tomorrow: quant smoke -> quality diff -> infra signoff -> onboard to private. Target timeline: 5 business days from kernel fix.

maria: Estimate compute: ~12 GPU-hours for full quant sweep + 6 GPU-hours for evals. Approve?

kai: Approved. I'll notify HelixHealth about timeline and budget estimate.

sophia: Tagging eng-sre for capacity reservation in private env. Need A100-80GB for baseline tests.

eng-sre-bot: Reservation requested: 1x A100-80GB reserved for 48h in us-west2. res_id=res-3344.

kai: Great. I'll follow up once we have green smoke runs. :thumbsup:
